queries.where:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS paid_total
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id;
queries.raw:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.amount) AS paid_total
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id;

queries.case:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END) AS paid_total
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id;
